nodes.summary: For a Galois extension `M / F` and any `F`-algebra `R`, the norm of an element of `R ⊗[F] M` over `R` is the product of its Galois conjugates.
nodes.title: Norm in a tensor product with a Galois extension
Galois extensions of the real numbers

nodes.summary: In an extension of prime degree, a nontrivial automorphism witnesses that the extension is Galois, has order equal to the degree, and generates the automorphism group.
nodes.title: Extensions of prime degree with a nontrivial automorphism are Galois

nodes.summary: If $L/K$ is a finite-dimensional abelian Galois extension, then the lattice of intermediate fields of $L/K$ is modular.
nodes.title: Intermediate fields of an abelian extension form a modular lattice

nodes.summary: Let $K/k$ be a Galois extension, not necessarily finite, and give $\operatorname{Gal}(K/k)$ the Krull topology. For every subgroup $H$ of $\operatorname{Gal}(K/k)$ with fixed field $K^H$, the closure of $H$ equals the subgroup of $\operatorname{Gal}(K/k)$ consisting of the automorphisms that fix $K^H$ pointwise.
nodes.title: The closure of a Galois subgroup is the fixing group of its fixed field

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
